title: Index-Relative Benchmarking Book -- IRB-1
description: A governed book of cohorts, each with a declared baseline index B and a measure series X, decomposed X = beta*B + epsilon into systematic + idiosyncratic parts. Cross-cohort comparisons are admitted only on a DIMENSIONLESS differential (idiosyncratic z-score, spread-to-baseline, cross-sectional rank) -- never an absolute level across a currency/region/legal-regime boundary. Grounds the estate omnirisk systematic/idiosyncratic factorization (RM-1). Measurement, simulation and audit only.

key.description: The cohort key. asset_class + market are required; issuer / rating_agency_bucket / region / sector refine it.

frame.description: The value frame the cohort's absolute levels live in (currency/venue). Two cohorts with differing frames may only be compared on a dimensionless basis.

baseline_index.description: The declared baseline index B. A cohort with no baseline index is REJECTED.

measure.description: The measure X to decompose against B. decomposed=false is REJECTED.

comparisons.description: Cross-cohort comparisons. basis must be dimensionless; an absolute basis across differing frames is REJECTED.

basis.description: Comparison basis. The dimensionless bases (idiosyncratic_z / spread_to_baseline / cross_sectional_rank) are cross-frame admissible; the absolute bases are only admissible within one frame.
